tools.name: Simplified Suite
tools.about: Team Simplified's open-source modding tools for F1 25. Simplified Studio makes .serps mods, and the suite adds the SERPs Launcher, a track installer, swappers, editors and a database merger. The Simplified Importer turns mods made with them into Swofty addons.

tools.name: EGO GameDatabases Editor
tools.about: PavelGames' standalone editor for the F1 games' databases. It edits drivers, teams, line-ups, tracks, the calendar, points and weather. Its key editor changes any value in the database.
